title: 1 Year Later, Spy x Family Finally Debunks The Main Villain’s Power With a Major Twist
content:
It’s been over a year since Spy x Family released Chapter 109, which shook the fandom with Melinda Desmond’s confession. After learning that Melinda is struggling with family issues, Yor suggested that she consult Loid Forger as his patient. However, fans never expected Melinda to reveal that not only can Donovan Desmond read people’s minds, but she also believes he is an alien. She believes her husband changed completely around the time her sons were born, but doesn’t exactly remember the details. However, Melinda is sure that her real husband is somewhere else in space while an alien has inhabited his body.

While Loid didn’t take her seriously, Anya, who is also a telepath, believed there must be some truth to this. Donovan is the primary target of WISE, and he’s also the reason why Loid was assigned to Operation Strix in the first place. As the leader of the National Unity Party, he is the prime suspect of being a warmonger. However, even though it’s been seven years since the manga’s debut, Donovan is still shrouded in mystery. While the manga hasn’t revealed much about him, the latest Chapter 139 Part 2 debunks the alien theory altogether.

Spy x Family Reveals Donovan Desmond Isn’t an Alien

The alien theory always sounded unbelievable to begin with, but the manga already confirmed that he’s just an ordinary human. Or at least, that’s what he wants others to believe. In Chapter 139 Part 2, Anya got close enough to him so she could read his mind. His words were incoherent, making it impossible for Anya to understand what he really meant. However, she realized that not only is Donovan a human, but he also doesn’t have telepathic powers.

This doesn’t mean he is ordinary by any means, since his thoughts about a certain research made Anya remember the horrible days she spent as a test subject. She even went to sleep with Yor since she was unable to sleep after that one-sided encounter. Not only that, but the scars on Donovan’s head also imply he could be a test subject as well. Whether he did it voluntarily or was forced to, he is still somehow connected to what happened to Anya in the past.

Anya wasn’t born with telepathic powers , but she was created in that way so she could prove to be useful to Ostania. As someone of his status, Donovan is aware of many things happening around him. He is hiding everything about himself from his wife and lives as a recluse so people wouldn’t learn his secret. As for what the secret is, the series might take a few months or even longer to reveal more about him.

title: 38 Years Later, Dragon Ball Is Due Yet Another Backstory For Vegeta With Manga’s Return
content:
Dragon Ball Super revived the series after two decades when Akira Toriyama returned with a brand new story for fans. While Toriyama served as the writer of the new manga, Toyotaro continued working with him as the illustrator. The series takes place not long after the Majin Buu Saga, focusing on the lives of Goku, his family, and the Z Fighters. This also includes Vegeta, who has changed significantly after the main story. Vegeta was introduced in the manga 38 years ago in Chapter 204 of the Saiyan Saga. While he was initially introduced as a major villain, he went through countless trials and tribulations to become the person he is today. The series also revealed everything he had to suffer because of Frieza.

Vegeta’s character development happened throughout the course of the story. Instead of turning him into a completely different person overnight, Toriyama ensured that his progress would seem even more fulfilling. The main story already introduced his father, the proud King Vegeta, who had no choice but to bow to Frieza if he wanted his planet to survive. Although it’s believed his mother is also dead, the series never revealed anything about her, not even her face. However, after the latest official alternate cover by Toyotaro , it’s more evident than ever that Dragon Ball Super needs to explore more about his past.

Vegeta Needs Another Backstory After The Alternate Cover of Dragon Ball Super

The cover shows the first glimpse of Vegeta’s mother in 38 years after his introduction. While it doesn’t actually reveal her face, fans do get confirmation that she was alive around the time Vegeta and his brother were kids. His mother is still a mystery to fans, but this first glimpse clearly points towards a possibility of another backstory. Toyotaro also confirmed that the idea of introducing Vegeta’s mother came to his mind suddenly.

This could also mean that fans might know more about her and Vegeta’s childhood if Dragon Ball Super returns. This wouldn’t only add more character depth to the Saiyan Prince, but also answer several questions about his mother. The manga has been on an indefinite hiatus since Toriyama’s death in March 2024. In February next year, Toyotaro returned with a special chapter before taking another long break.

The artist will be taking over the helm in both art and story, and he clearly has big shoes to fill. The long hiatus is reasonable considering the pressure he has been facing to live up to fans’ expectations. While the manga doesn’t have a return date yet, Toyotaro has already confirmed he will be returning with the manga . While fans await the manga’s return, Dragon Ball Super will be continuing the story in the Galactic Patrol anime, which will continue the story after the Tournament of Power Arc.

title: Chainsaw Man Creator Breaks Silence on Acclaimed One-Shot’s Live-Action
content:
Tatsuki Fujimoto is one of the most celebrated manga creators in recent years. While he is best known for Chainsaw Man , he has also created Fire Punch and several acclaimed one-shots. One of his one-shots, Look Back , gained worldwide recognition in 2024 after its anime adaptation. The award-winning film became a global hit as it follows a heartbreaking story of two aspiring manga creators. Produced by Studio DURIAN, the gorgeous anime was praised for its nuanced story with emotional moments. Following the anime film’s success, a live-action adaptation was also confirmed . The film will hit Japanese theatres on September 11th, 2026, but hasn’t confirmed a global release date yet.

However, GKIDS will be bringing the live-action film to fans in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Ireland soon after. The film is already making waves thanks to its excellent cast and crew, especially Hirokazu Kore-eda, Palme d’Or winner and Oscar-nominated filmmaker, best known for Shoplifters . He is serving as the writer, editor, and director of the film. As the release date of the film draws near, Fujimoto got early access, and he’s more than impressed by the adaptation.

Tatsuki Fujimoto Praises Look Back Live-Action Film

According to Oricon , Fujimoto shared, “I was very happy because, without losing the tone of the original manga, the film was able to bring out the atmosphere that the original had while giving it a real sense of authenticity.”

Live-action adaptations are infamous for straying away from the original source, often leading to criticisms and fans’ complaints. While live-actions often take creative liberties with the original story, they are not always the best way to go about the story. Even a well-received adaptation like One Piece wasn’t exempt from that, and the number of changes made by Netflix is astounding.

However, while One Piece became a massive global hit, not many live-action adaptations become famous for the very same reason. Considering many such cases, Look Back is surely an exception for following the original tone of the manga as much as possible. While Fujimoto praises the film, he also implies that the film will have changes from the original source. Regardless, now that the creator has given it his approval, it’s all the more reason to look forward to it.

Look Back Is Getting a New Home Video Release in September

Last month, GKIDS also confirmed that the anime film will release a 4K UHD Collector’s Edition . While it’s already available for pre-order on the official website of GKIDS, the home video will be released on September 8th, 2026. It’s available in both Japanese and English audio with subtitles in multiple languages, including English, Spanish, and French. Fans will also get several exciting bonuses such as an interview with the director and cast members, a 160-page book, and more. Even though two years have passed since the film’s debut, it continues to stay in the spotlight thanks to these new releases.

title: Manga Mavericks Books Licenses Midnight Robot, 'Arai-kun & Haruma-senpai' Manga
content:
Manga Mavericks Books announced during its Anime NYC panel on Friday that it has licensed the following manga:

Title: Midnight Robot ( Yoru no Robot ) Creator: Yōhei Sajita Release: May 2027 Summary: Boys and girls, it's time to get in the robot!

Fumiko Daidouji has become used to her dad not being in her life, until he suddenly returns home with a gift: a screw lodged into her cranium! He claims it's to protect her from a secret, nameless organization, and not surprisingly, she figures her Dad has a screw loose himself.

However, the organization is very real - and they want Fumiko's screw to summon a giant robot! Dragged against her will into a battle to save the world, Fumiko quickly realizes that her once ordinary life is gone. Now, she faces world destruction, a parallel cosmos, and the midnight robot that connects them all.

Sajita previously began self-publishing Midnight Robot in 2015. Hayakawa Publishing began publishing the manga on its Hayacomi website in 2024, where it is ongoing. Hayakawa Publishing released the manga's second compiled book volume in September 2025

Title: Arai-kun & Haruma-senpai ( Arai-kun to Haruma-senpai ) Creator: Akahachi Release: December 2026 (digital), June 2027 (print) Summary: Haruma Ohara is the charming, athletic upperclassman. Ao Arai is the adorably shy, chubby underclassman. Simply a match made…in an elevator?

A chance encounter in an elevator between a rushed introvert and a charismatic jock grows into a fluffy, slow-burn love story. The introverted Arai is swept up in the charm of the extroverted Haruma, and before he knows it, they've exchanged contact information and keep running into each other all over campus. It's clear to everyone that Haruma's crush is immediate, but how long will it take for Arai to notice his own feelings?

Akahachi published the manga in April 2023.

Manga Mavericks Books also announced that, with permission from Fairbell Inc. and Yumiko Igarashi , it has been recovering and restoring color illustrations from the original serialization of the The Sword of Paros manga, and will include those illustrations in the English release. The company has put out an open call for anyone who has leads on finding several issues of the Monthly Asuka magazine from 1986 and 1987.

title: Mahjong Pros Licenses Snap Call Kirinji, Riichi Mahjong 101 Manga
content:
Mahjong set company Mahjong Pros ' Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint announced at Anime NYC on Friday that it has licensed the following manga:

So Rinji decides to do the one thing he knows how to do: play mahjong for money. But dominating online is one thing. Making a living in Tokyo's real-world mahjong parlors means facing hustlers, veterans, eccentrics, and killers at the table who have spent their lives paying for cash. Armed with his talent at onling mahjong, Rinji sets out to prove that the one thing that made him a failure might also be the thing that finally makes him a father.

Learn how to plan a hand from your starting tiles, adapt as new tiles arrive, build efficient shapes, decide when to keep a safe tile, recognize when a hand is worth pursuing, and choose whether or not to declare Riichi. Each hand introduces fundamental concepts naturally through play, with additional practice problems and concise strategy lessons to reinforce what you've learned

The Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint focuses on licensing, localizing, and distributing mahjong-themed manga and textbooks. The company announced its Mahjong Pros Publishing imprint in June 2025.

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Creator Returns With a New Series Ahead of Anime’s Debut
content:
It’s no secret among manga fans that Shonen Jump often cancels series for varying reasons. It doesn’t have much to do with the story; rather, sales or viewership matter most to publishers. In February 2024, Shun Numa returned to Weekly Shonen Jump with a new gag humor series, Super Psychic Policeman Chojo . The manga released 69 chapters before reaching an anticlimactic ending only a year after its debut. However, the series surprised Shonen Jump fans with an anime adaptation only a few months after its cancellation. While it’s not Numa’s first serialized manga, it’s the only one that has confirmed an anime adaptation.

Despite the promising story and premise, the series never got the chance it deserved, but the anime adaptation might change that. The manga has been gaining a lot of recognition since its cancellation, which is why it ranked third in the Next Manga Award. The anime series will premiere on October 6th as part of the 2026 fall lineup. As the anime’s release date is closer than ever, Shun Numa will be starting a brand new series in collaboration with another creator.

What to Know About The New Weekly Shonen Jump Manga By Shun Numa

Numa is working with Yushin Kuroki, whose only serialized manga is Teenage Renaissance! David. While the official English title hasn’t been revealed yet, it’s translated to Behind the Scenes Report by @WSJ_manga on X. The account also shared that the manga will debut in Weekly Shonen Jump Issue #40. We can expect the manga to land on the official Manga Plus app on August 23rd, 2026. This is Numa’s first manga after the cancellation of Super Psychic Policeman Chojo .

Not only that, but it’s also the first time he is collaborating with another artist for a weekly serialization. It’s currently unknown if Numa will be focusing on the story or the art, and considering his previous track record, it could be either of those. Additionally, Kuroki is an even more underrated WSJ creator, whose only serialized manga began in September 2018. It was cancelled only a few months later in 2019, and this will be his first project after all these years.

What Is Super Psychic Policeman Chojo About?

The story takes place in a world where talented psychics use their powers to solve crimes. They are known as Police Investigators and have incredible abilities like telepathy and psychometry. However, since only the most talented psychics can join the FBI or CIA, most of them end up joining the police force due to their average powers. Meguru Chojo is one such police officer working in a small police station in West Shinjuku.

The story centers around his daily shenanigans with his partner, Nao Ippongi, as they continue to solve every crime that they stumble upon. All chapters of the manga are available on the official Manga Plus app. You can also read the manga online on Viz Media, where links to buying the manga volumes are also available.

title: Futurama Reveals Season 14 Preview of New Character, Coco Charm (Exclusive)
content:
Earlier this month, Hulu welcomed back the world that introduced us to the likes of Fry, Bender, Leela, and the other employees of the Planet Express for its fourteenth season. Rather than releasing all the episodes of this latest season at once, Futurama has instead decided to go with a weekly schedule. On Monday, August 24th, not only is a new episode of the beloved animated series set to drop, but a new character will be joining the animated show’s ranks. Coco Charm is set to take the Futurama world by storm, and we here at ComicBook.com have a first look at the animated pop star.

Coco is described as the “biggest pop star” in the galaxy, according to the Futurama crew, who has a surprising secret up her sleeve. Much like the now-legendary “hypno-toad,” Charm takes control of a hypnotized army that is more than willing to take part in whatever orders she bestows upon them. While Coco might be a new addition to the series, voice actor Dawnn Lewis has plenty of history in bringing Futurama characters to life . For those who might not know, Lewis has long played the role of LaBarbara Conrad, Hermes’ long-time partner, while also taking on other parts throughout the show’s history. Having also starred in series such as Star Trek: Lower Decks, Rick and Morty, Regular Show, The Cleveland Show , and Static Shock , Dawnn’s resume is an expansive one. Luckily, the Futurama crew was more than willing to dive further into Coco’s upcoming introduction.

The Dawnn of Coco

To start, “ The Charm Offensive ” director Andrew Han explained how the team studied various pop stars throughout history to help in creating Coco’s look: “When we first got the script for this episode and were coming up with ideas for Coco Charm, we looked at pop stars for inspiration, but I wanted to incorporate elements of K-Pop to Coco Charm. You can see that we experimented with various hairstyles and outfits before coming to her final designs. You’ll notice when watching the episode the inspiration from pop stars and K-Pop in ways how she performs and how her fans interact with her. Coco goes through multiple outfits throughout the episode, and the voice acting/singing of Dawnn Lewis. I hope people look forward to seeing her performance!”

Alongside Han, character designer Alice Darrow reiterated the pop star exploration, while also explaining Charm’s more ‘militaristic’ aesthetic: “When I first got the assignment to design Coco Charm, I immediately looked to existing pop stars for inspiration, because they always have really fun stage outfits that I thought would translate to animation really well. For her signature sparkly bodysuit, I knew I needed to go through Thierry Mugler, Jean Paul Gaultier, and Versace archives to find some fun inspiration. I looked at a lot of Bob Mackie gowns too.

Darrow continued, “Coco’s military look was a clear reference to David Byrne’s iconic “Stop Making Sense” big suit, but it still needed to be cute and inspire both fear and obedience. Military uniforms are very ornate, so it can be a challenge to capture the silhouette without going overboard on the details. The director, Andrew Han, usually has a precise idea of what he wants for a design, so the process is very smooth. As you can see here, he was the architect behind her iconic two-tone bangs!”

Finally, episode director Cody Ziglar explained the musical influences for Coco while praising the performance of voice actor Dawnn Lewis, “Coco Charm is definitely a love letter to (and amalgamation of) some of my favorite pop & rock stars from throughout the years. Especially those that leaned heavily into military/big suit looks for some of their on-stage performances/personas. Folks like David Byrne, Janet Jackson, and My Chemical Romance. And speaking of performances, Dawnn Lewis did an absolutely amazing job — she improvised the melodies for every song, first take, and then went back and layered them for an actual performance! Anyone familiar with Dawnn’s history knows what she’s capable of, but seeing it in person was a true gift. Rough Draft knocked her designs out of the park!”

Futurama’s fourteenth season is currently streaming on Hulu, with its fifth episode, “The Charm Offensive,” set to arrive on August 24th next week.

title: Boruto Next Generations Streaming on BBC iPlayer
content:
The website AnimeBluRayUK reports that BBC iPlayer is now streaming the 66 TV episodes of the series Boruto: Naruto Next Generations in their English-dubbed version.

The series premiered on TV Tokyo in 2017, featuring an original story. The series featured returning cast members from Naruto Shippūden and Boruto -Naruto the Movie- . Naruto Shippūden episode director Noriyuki Abe was chief director, and Hiroyuki Yamashita returned from Boruto -Naruto the Movie- to direct at Studio Pierrot . Ukyō Kodachi , author of the Boruto manga, supervised the story. Makoto Uezu ( Scum's Wish , My Bride is a Mermaid ) was in charge of series composition. Tetsuya Nishio and Hirofumi Suzuki returned to design the characters. Hideyuki Ueno ( Ace of Diamond , NANA) was the art director, and Yasushi Nagura ( The Future Diary , Wagnaria!!2 ) was the sound director.

Ukyō Kodachi and Mikie Ikemoto launched the Boruto manga in Weekly Shonen Jump on May 9, based on and as a sequel to Masashi Kishimoto 's Naruto manga. Boruto 's titular main character was the protagonist of the Boruto -Naruto the Movie- anime film.

title: Upcoming Anime Screenings at London's Prince Charles Cinema
content:
The Prince Charles cinema in Leicester Square, London, will screen several anime films into November.

Tickets for the films are available here and all the screenings are subtitled.

Makoto Shinkai 's your name. (pictured right) will be screened on Thursday August 27 (12 noon), Monday September 7 (6.15 p.m.), Tuesday September 15 (2.35 p.m.), Wednesday September 23 (2.45 p.m.), Friday November 20 (6 p.m.) and Thursday November 26 (3.30 p.m.)

Rintarō 's Metropolis will be screened on Monday August 24 (5.45 p.m.)

Mamoru Oshii 's Angel's Egg (4K) will be screened on Tuesday August 25 (12 noon). Wednesday August 26 (5.45 p.m.), Thursday September 3 (3:20 p.m.), Wednesday September 9 (5.45 p.m.), Tuesday September 22 (6.15 p.m.)

Satoshi Kon 's Perfect Blue (pictured left) will be screened on Friday August 28 (6 p.m.), Sunday October 4 (12.30 p.m.), Sunday October 11 (8.45 p.m.) Wednesday October 14 (12 noon), Thursday October 22 (3.30 p.m.), Saturday October 24 (5:30 p.m.), Tuesday October 27 (6 p.m.), Saturday October 31 (10 a.m.), Sunday November 1 (6.05 p.m.). Screenings are marked as 4K except the final screening on November 1.

Katsuhiro Ōtomo 's Akira will be screened on Sunday August 30 (2:10 p.m.), Friday September 25 (3 p.m.), Saturday September 26 (5 p.m.), Sunday September 27 (8.35 p.m.), Wednesday September 30 (2.45 p.m.), Friday November 6 (8.45 p.m.), Saturday November 7 (2.35 p.m.), Tuesday November 10 (3 p.m.), Thursday November 12 (8.45 p.m.), Friday November 27 (11.15 a.m.) Screenings are marked as 35mm except for the first screening on August 30 and the final screening on November 27, which are both marked as 4K screenings.

Satoshi Kon 's Paprika will be screened on Wednesday September 2 (12 noon) and Monday September 14 (6.15 p.m.) The second screening is listed as 4K.

Hayao Miyazaki 's Kiki's Delivery Service will be screened on Saturday September 12 (11.55 a.m.), Thursday September 17 (3.20 p.m.) and Sunday September 27 (12 noon). The first two screenings are listed as 4K.

Mamoru Oshii 's Ghost in the Shell 4K will be screened on Tuesday September 15 at 5.45 p.m.

Satoshi Kon 's Millennium Actress 4K will be screened on Thursday October 1 at 11.50 a.m.

Evangelion : Death (True)² and The End of Evangelion will be screened on Friday November 13 at 8.30 p.m.
